Every table declares how it grows. growth: time = row count grows with elapsed time; fleet = bounded by fleet/org size; static = reference data; unmeasured = empty in production when this landed, legal ONLY while listed in check-table-lifecycle.mjs's UNMEASURED ratchet, which may only shrink. retention_days MIRRORS RETENTION_RULES in apps/api/src/modules/org/dataRetention.ts and is the window IN FORCE, never a proposal — the gate fails if the two disagree, so a window and its registry entry move in one commit. null = no rule (evidence, or a rollup small enough to keep forever). budget_rows_per_day is fleet-wide and is checked by the L8 growth judge, NOT by the gate: a gate cannot see production.
